before_source: Copied, tested native dev executables from before this optimization pass.
after_source: Committed native performance changes with current dev file IO/byte integration. Benchmark source, input sizes, C baselines and determinism flags are unchanged.
protocol: Five repetitions per concept and variant. Run life, nbody, events sequentially in each repetition; alternate before/fixed order each repetition. Start only after agent/root builds and tests finish. Each executable times Tide and unchanged C implementations with matching one-thread and twelve-thread configurations. Default warmup/tick counts retained. No phase timers in measured builds.
aggregation: Median of five reported tick medians; ranges of those medians. Ratio is median of each run Tide time / fastest C implementation time, not ratio of independently aggregated medians.

validation.end_state_digests: All thirty final runs pass and agree within each concept across before/fixed and C ways.
validation.floats: Finite reduction order, signed zero, subnormals and infinity-preserving results compare exact bytes. NaN-producing sqrt inputs compare classification, following the existing language contract that NaN payload bits are not portable. The original pre-pass compiler also fails the exploratory NaN-payload oracle. No production NaN canonicalization or math flag changes.
validation.observable_behavior: Queue format/hash/packed bytes, page crossings and reuse, C observers/defaults/constants, sparse filters, deferred event order, handler-appended events, snapshots/unpacked worlds, task tails and loop bounds tested.

native_nbody_assembly.description: Counts in final generated game object; vector inner loop and scalar tail use exact hardware math.

diagnostics.outcome: Initial three repetitions per concept before experiments.

diagnostics.source: Baseline versus ignored generated-C prototype caching mutable Health columns during compatible event replay
diagnostics.outcome: About 9% improvement; replay prototype discarded. No replay cache retained.

diagnostics.source: Baseline versus ignored generated-C prototype reserving page runs for Shoot
diagnostics.outcome: About 23% improvement motivated generic pure-send production path; final code and final timing rows are separate.

diagnostics.source: Copied baseline versus early generic list batching before final IO integration and guards
diagnostics.outcome: Timing drift inflated baseline and C runs. Exploratory gains motivated final exclusive alternating comparison; use final labels for claims.

diagnostics.source: Ignored generated-C byte-window experiments after relative addressing
diagnostics.outcome: Inconclusive/noisy; no byte lowering retained. See native-performance-life-diagnostics.json.

limitations: Runtime timings here are for this Windows machine only. Web tests establish correctness, not a web speedup.
Life twelve-thread ranges overlap, so no consistent worker speedup is claimed.
Events and Life still take about seven times as long as the best C comparison; graphics still has no direct handwritten GPU baseline.
Earlier diagnostics had visible machine variation. No machine-dependent timing threshold is a correctness test.
